name: Backed GOVIES 0-6 months EURO investment grade
oneLiner: bC3M is Backed's NAV-accreting tracker token for Amundi's short-dated Eurozone government bond UCITS ETF, KYC-gated and registered under Swiss DLT Act.
collateral: Tracker certificate fully backed by the AMUNDI ETF GOVIES 0-6 MONTHS EUROMTS INVESTMENT GRADE UCITS ETF, held in segregated custody and administered by Backed Assets (Jersey) Limited under Swiss DLT Act framework
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting tracker token (not pegged to €1); price reflects the underlying short-term Eurozone government bond ETF NAV with continuous yield accrual; KYC-gated 1:1 primary mint and redemption via Backed; secondary liquidity on Uniswap and CoW Protocol

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Backed identifies bC3M as an ERC-20 tracker certificate for the Amundi 0-6 month Eurozone government-bill ETF. Its value follows that short-duration sovereign-bill ETF rather than a fixed one-euro claim, so the existing tbill archetype is retained as the closest supported V9 category.

notices.title: Multi-chain Backed product
notices.message: bC3M is listed across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, and Gnosis with the same token address. Pharos keeps those verified Backed deployments grouped under the native multichain product.

notices.title: No on-chain reserve feed today
notices.message: Unlike bIB01, Backed has not published a Chainlink LedgerLens Proof-of-Reserve or NAV feed for bC3M on any chain. Reserves remain on the curated path until an on-chain feed is available.
